title: Combat Conductor
description:
In this 3D rhythm action game, you fight using a conductor's baton.

Watch enemy attacks, perform Beat Strikes and take on the giant machine PT-333.

Staying on beat will give you a big advantage in battle!

● RHYTHM IS YOUR POWER♪ Time your Beat Strikes with the rhythm to deal more damage.

♪ Keep the rhythm going with Beat Strikes and dodges to boost your attack power, defense and movement speed.

♪ Battle to the beat until the end of the music and bring down the machine!

● LIBERATE THE INSTRUMENTS AND WEAKEN PT-333♪ Chain Beat Strikes together to get the chance to use your Special Move.

♪ During the Special Move chance, stay on rhythm to activate your Special Move and liberate the instruments.

♪ Liberate the instruments PT-333 uses as weapons and greatly weaken it.

● PRACTICE MAKES PERFECT♪ Your battle performance is judged by your score and rank. Keep playing and get the highest score you can!

－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－

[NOTICE]

This game was created as part of Byking Inc.'s new employee training program. 

Depending on your PC environment, the game may not run properly or unexpected issues may occur. 

A keyboard and mouse or controller is required to play.

description_short: A 3D rhythm action game where you use a conductor's baton to take on a giant machine clad in musical instruments. Watch for the enemy's attacks, perform Beat Strikes and take on the giant machine PT-333 while fighting to the rhythm.
